name: A trip without an entry date is rejected

planSteps.description: Navigate to /?today=2026-10-19&fresh=1 (pins today to 2026-10-19 and clears saved trips)
Leave the entry date (data-testid=trip-entry) empty, enter exit date 2026-09-10 (data-testid=trip-exit), and click save (data-testid=trip-save)
The form error (data-testid=trip-form-error) reads 'Enter an entry date.'
